source: make a game called "Ava's betrayal" where the main character called Ava gets betrayed by her best friend honor who left her for avas EVIL ex best friend Monique. the game starts off in a school called bloxdale high, which ranges from grade 1 to graduation. the game is a story game with choices to be made. you can decide what options to choose. the story line starts at the start of the year. Harley, Ava's bestie recently came back to school . the days pass by calmly, Harley even gains a new crush and ava makes more friends. then they made a new friend honor. and then she slowly becomes their bestie. the small trio slowly turns into a group\nwith honor, Monique Harley and ava. they love each other! theyre so happy. then, Monique slowly turns bitter. she gets angry and turns her back to ava and Harley. slowly clinging onto honor. days past, then weeks, ava gets angry at monique. and harley follows. they stop playing with monqiue at lunch. honor plays with other friends. this goes on for a few days till it's stopped cause Monique told the teacher. they get called in the teachers office and get yelled at for leaving Monique out. they try explaining they don't wanna be friends with her anymore, but the teacher dosent listen. then, Harley leaves for vacation, and two days before Harley comes back to school, ava messages her frantically explaining how honor turned her back and betrayed us, even saying that honor said Harley was rude and if ava still liked her she wouldn't be her friend anymore. Harley was shocked and then they both decided that when Harley came back from vacation they'd stop interacting with both of them forever. honor and Monique confront ava and harley. the player, playing as ava gets a choice to either say "back off! youre so fake. never talk to us again, we'll tell the teachers!" or "your right. I'm sorry, lets be friends again. we were in the wrong." or an option to just walk away and kick dust in their face. theres a bad ending if you pick forgive them. another story line will start that will lead to a bad, ending. kicking dust in their face leads to a secret ending because it will be hidden on your screen. and obviously refusing is a good endinand also they are all girls, and their uniforms are pretty basic. they have Navy plaid patterned skirts, and a white t shirt with a collar, and a choice of a cardigan or a jacket. Harley wears a jacket, honor ava and Monique wear cardigans.

the lunch area and common spaces where the friend group gathers and later splits

standing positions for the four named characters - Ava, Harley, Honor and Monique - in the hallway, the lunch area and the teacher's office

notes: The Story preset pins world-chaptered and P4, but every scene in this story happens inside one school, so the chapters co-exist on one surface and world-open was taken instead - the genre notes explicitly warn against tagging P4 when chapters share a map
reveal-exit is preset baggage and carries the P3 in this route; there is no vista to reveal inside a school
The prompt is overwhelmingly a script - characters, dialogue, choices and endings - and almost none of it has a destination in this network
Uniform detail (navy plaid skirts, white collared shirts, cardigans, one jacket) is character art, not layout

answers.ask: How much of the school should exist - just the rooms the story visits, or a whole navigable campus?
answers.answer: Just build the rooms and connecting hallways the story visits, so it stays a focused story game rather than a whole campus.

answers.ask: Which locations do the scenes actually need? I have a hallway, a cafeteria and the teacher's office from the story.
answers.answer: Use a classroom for the start-of-year and friendship scenes, the hallway, cafeteria/lunch area, teacher's office, and a small outdoor school courtyard for the final confrontation.

answers.ask: The story runs across a school year - should the map change between the start of the year and the confrontation, or stay the same?
answers.answer: Keep the same school map throughout; use simple day-to-day progression rather than seasonal map changes.

answers.ask: Do the three endings need different spaces, or do they all play out in the same place?
answers.answer: All three endings should play out at the same outdoor courtyard confrontation space, with different dialogue and ending scenes based on Ava's choice.
